notes: External override of PeerReference.releasePeer - for uda/NativeHeap-style peers (not COM IUnknown) this deallocates the native heap-side resource identified by peerHandle rather than decrementing a COM refcount. Cross-referenced against IUnknownReference.releasePeer, which shares the same signature but different native semantics (COM Release vs. native free) - both kept as 'releasePeer' since the abstract contract name already fits both cases.
